description: Packages that scripts/check-licenses.mjs accepts although their license is not permissive or not machine-readable. Each entry names the license string the check saw, so a license change fails the check again. A trailing * in name matches a prefix. The policy is in docs/licenses.md.

npm.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
npm.reason: Proprietary, published under Anthropic's legal agreements. Its JavaScript ships unchanged; use in a distributed product falls under the Commercial Terms. Listed in NOTICE.

npm.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*
npm.reason: Native Claude Code binaries. electron-builder.yml excludes them from the app; the user installs Claude Code.

python.name: pypdfium2
python.reason: Wheel of PDFium (BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0) with its bundled libraries, which carry permissive licenses (see the licenses directory in the wheel). Installed by uv on the user's machine, not shipped by citegeist.
